tools.name: Remote Sensing VQA Model
tools.description: Answers natural language questions about land cover, spectral characteristics, and features in satellite imagery.

tools.name: Remote Sensing Scene Captioner
tools.description: Generates structured scene descriptions, land cover summaries, and object counts.

tools.name: Text-Guided Region Grounding Model
tools.description: Localizes target objects, water bodies, urban zones, or agricultural plots specified in text queries.

tools.name: Bi-Temporal Change Understanding Engine
tools.description: Detects land cover transitions, infrastructure changes, and flood inundation between two dates, generating a spatial change map and textual change explanation.

tools.name: Optical-SAR Cross-Modal Fusion Engine
tools.description: Fuses co-registered Optical spectral features with SAR structural/backscatter radar signals for day/night and cloud-resilient joint land-use classification.
